name: Elizabeth Craigmyle
bio: Elizabeth (Bessie) Craigmyle (1863–1933) was a Scottish poet and translator.
Her books include Poems and Translations (1886) and A Handful of Pansies (1888). She is represented here by a Scots ballad lyric from Stedman’s Victorian Anthology (1895).

poems.title: Solway Sands
poems.author: Elizabeth Craigmyle
poems.text:
Twa race doon by the Gatehope-Slack,
When nicht is wearin' near to the noon,
He on the gray and she on the black;
Her faither and brithers are hard on the track,
And Solway sands are white in the moon.
